description: YDS ve e-YDS sınavlarında en sık test edilen mantıksal bağlaçlar haritası

categories.explanation: İki bağımsız veya denk durum arasındaki zıtlığı veya farkı ifade eder.

items.grammar: Nokta veya noktalı virgül sonrası gelir, virgülle ayrılır
items.example: The initial results were promising; however, subsequent trials failed to replicate them.

items.grammar: Geçiş zarfıdır, cümle başında veya ortasında virgülle kullanılır
items.example: The cost of offshore wind is high; nevertheless, investments continue to accelerate.

items.grammar: İki tam cümleyi (S+V) bağlar, virgülle iki durumu kıyaslar
items.example: Some nations subsidize fossil fuels, whereas others impose heavy carbon penalties.
Nuclear energy produces zero emissions; on the other hand, waste storage remains unresolved.

categories.explanation: Beklenen sonucun tersinin gerçekleştiğini bildirir (bir engele rağmen).

items.example: Although the patient exhibited severe symptoms, antibiotic therapy proved effective.

items.grammar: İsim (Noun) veya V-ing alır, CÜMLE ALMAZ!
items.example: Despite rigorous security protocols, malware compromised the central server.
Notwithstanding public skepticism, the municipal subway project finished ahead of schedule.

categories.explanation: Bir eylemin veya durumun arkasındaki gerekçeyi ifade eder.

items.example: Since the sample was contaminated, technicians had to restart the culture assay.

items.connector: due to / owing to / on account of
items.example: The flight was grounded due to severe turbulence across the mountain pass.

items.grammar: İsim alır, genellikle olumlu sebep bildirir
items.example: Thanks to early vaccination coverage, the outbreak was contained within weeks.

categories.explanation: Bir durumun veya eylemin doğurduğu sonucu gösterir.

items.example: The treaty was never ratified; therefore, international sanctions remained in place.
Drought degraded topsoil; consequently, agricultural output dropped forty percent.

items.grammar: so + adj/adv + that / such + (a/an) + adj + noun + that
items.example: The earthquake was so destructive that entire residential sectors were demolished.

categories.explanation: Bir durumun gerçekleşmesi için gerekli koşulu ifade eder.

items.connector: if / provided that / as long as
items.example: Provided that funding is secured, construction of the observatory will commence.

items.grammar: if not anlamına gelir, olumlu yapı içinde olumsuz anlam taşır
items.example: Unless greenhouse emissions fall, coastal cities will face frequent flooding.

items.grammar: Nokta veya noktalı virgülden sonra gelir
items.example: Farmers must irrigate early; otherwise, topsoil moisture evaporates rapidly.
